about: Session plan (all reflectors within 2 m): one take = 20 frames (2 s). Record with  python -m core.capture --cli COM4 --session S1 --plan data/session_plan.json --name <name> [--target 'R:theta:label' ...]  The targets below are PLANNED positions: pass the MEASURED ones with --target, or correct data/raw/<session>/<name>.json before running run_experiment.py. Angles: positive = to the right seen from the radar; R from the EVM front-face centre to the reflector apex. Heights: antenna_height_m = centre of the antenna area, apex_height_m = apex of each reflector, both from the floor; the capture tool turns them into z = apex - antenna and stores the 3-D range, angle and elevation (core/truth.py). After correcting a height here: python -m core.capture --session S1 --plan data/session_plan.json --update-truth

geometry.about: room S1/S2 in radar coordinates (x along the boresight, y sideways, + = right), metres; approximate (tape)

big CR.about: large trihedral corner reflector (gold, 8 cm); the antenna centre is about 1 cm higher. Tape to the inner corner (apex). Session S2 only: taped at the front rim, apex 5 cm deeper (apex_depth_m 0.05 stored in the S2 take files)

small CR 1.about: small trihedral on the HIGH stand

small CR 2.about: small trihedral on the LOW stand (same size as 1)

takes.name: empty
takes.setup: nothing in front of the radar: reflectors AND stands behind it; operator behind the radar
takes.tests: background subtraction (room, lane, walls, TX-RX leakage)

takes.name: null
takes.setup: the same empty scene, recorded again (nothing in front of the radar: reflectors AND stands behind it; operator behind the radar)
takes.tests: false alarms of every DoA and range method on real noise and clutter

takes.name: cal_0deg
takes.setup: big CR at boresight, 2.0 m (in the strip in front of the radar)

takes.name: single_m30
takes.setup: small CR 1, 2.0 m, 30 deg left (beyond the lane)
takes.tests: single target; sign of the angle axis

takes.name: single_m45
takes.setup: small CR 1, 1.8 m, 45 deg left (beyond the lane)
takes.tests: single target at a large angle (scale of the angle axis)

takes.name: single_p10
takes.setup: small CR 1, 1.5 m, 10 deg RIGHT (y = +0.26 m; the right side is free to about 0.5-0.6 m)
takes.tests: single target at a positive angle (both sides of boresight)

takes.name: multi_doa
takes.setup: two small CRs in ONE range gate: both 1.50 m (measure to 1 cm), 23 deg apart (one beyond the lane, one in the strip)
takes.tests: multi-target DoA: equal pair that only the angle can separate

takes.name: multi_strong_weak
takes.setup: big CR (beyond the lane) and small CR 1 (in the strip), both 1.50 m
takes.tests: weak reflector next to a strong one (masking, calibration ghosts)

takes.name: multi_range
takes.setup: small CR 1 straight ahead (strip), small CR 2 (beyond the rail) and big CR on the left table section (x >= 1 m); 10-25 deg apart, none hides another
takes.tests: multi-target RANGE estimation (FFT vs CZT) and DoA across several range gates

takes.name: multi_range_close
takes.setup: two small CRs 17 cm apart in range (2 range cells), 24 deg apart in angle
takes.tests: multi-target range RESOLUTION at 2 range cells (FFT bins vs CZT zoom); a static pair's resolution depends on its phase difference, shift one reflector by 1-2 cm for a second look

takes.name: multi_same_az
takes.setup: SAME azimuth (0 deg): small CR 2 (low stand, 27 cm) in front at 1.50 m, small CR 1 (high stand, 42 cm) directly behind it at 1.67 m; the height difference keeps the rear one visible (check the sight line from behind the radar)
takes.tests: two reflectors that only RANGE can separate (2 range cells, identical angle): two detections, not one

takes.name: multi_close_az
takes.setup: same range 1.50 m (measure both to 1 cm), 6 deg apart = 0.6 of the array resolution (9.6 deg); low and high stand side by side (about 16 cm apart)
takes.tests: two reflectors closer in angle than the array resolution (super-resolution): two detections, not one

room: S1/S2: metal rail (low, < 20 cm high) along the boresight, occupying y = -0.44 to -0.55 m; right side free to about 0.5-0.6 m, then the wall (strong static echo at y of about +0.7 m); corner about 2.85 m ahead. Free floor: beyond the rail (y <= -0.6 m) and the strip -0.15 m <= y <= +0.15 m in front of the radar, x <= 2.1 m. Evaluation region 0.5-2.5 m, y <= +0.45 m. Left of the lane the radar's L-shaped table starts only at x of about 1 m: no reflector at x < 1 m there.
